title: Job Inbox
intro: Ten job messages. One minute. Real offers exist too.
Swipe left if it is a scam, right if it is safe. Or tap the buttons.
Careful: some are honest. Do not cry wolf.

cards.text: Thanks for applying for Junior Designer. Please pick a time for your interview on our careers page.
cards.why: You applied, and it asks for nothing but a time on the company's own page.

cards.text: Earn ₹3,000 daily from home, no experience. Message me now!
cards.why: A cold DM with big pay and no experience needed.

cards.text: Like 3 videos, get ₹450 at once. Join our group: taskflow-earn.in/join
cards.why: Pay for liking videos, with a small payout first.

cards.text: Offer letter: pay ₹9,500 for your laptop kit within 24 hours.
cards.why: No real employer charges you for a kit.

cards.text: Your interview is on Tuesday at 3 PM on our company video link. No fees at any stage.
cards.why: It follows your application and asks for nothing.

cards.text: Job abroad, ₹2,00,000 a month. Pay ₹80,000 agent fee to start.
cards.why: A huge salary and a big agent fee up front.

cards.text: We are hiring a data entry clerk. Register with ₹1,200 to get your login.
cards.why: A registration fee for a job is a scam.

cards.text: Your first 3 tasks are done. Top up ₹6,000 in crypto for the next set.
cards.why: A crypto top-up to keep working.

cards.text: Your background check is clear. Welcome! Your start date is Monday. Your laptop will be posted to you.
cards.why: It shares good news, asks for nothing, and the company sends the laptop.

cards.text: Student part-time job: ₹800 per hour. Send ₹500 to unlock the link.
cards.why: You pay ₹500 to be paid ₹800. It is a trap.

golden_rule: A real job never asks you to pay, and a real recruiter replies to something you did. Check the company's own page.

quick_check.q: A job message asks you to pay a fee to get started. What is true?

options.text: It is normal for good jobs
Real jobs never ask you to pay to get started
It is fine if the fee is small
It is fine if it is refundable

quick_check.explain: Honest employers never charge. A small fee is the bait.
